lines.t: Like an apple tree among the trees or the woods
So is my beloved among the suns
I sat down in his shade with great delight
And his fruit was sweet to my taste
The voice of my beloved
Behold, he comes
Leaping upon the mountains
Skipping upon the hills
My beloved is mine and I am his
He is the chief among ten thousand
His left hand is under my head
And his right hand embraces me
Sustain me with cakes of raisins
Refresh me with apples
For I am lovesick
Tell me who you are, my love, where you feed your flock
Where you make it rest at noon
By night on my bed, I saw the one I love
I sought him, but I did not find him
I will rise now
I said, and go about the city
In the streets and in the squares
I will seek the one I love
I sought him, but I did not find him
My beloved is mine and I am his
He is the chief among ten thousand
His left hand is under my head
And his right hand embraces me
Sustains me with kicks of raisins
Refresh me with apples
For I am lovesick
Set me as a seal upon your heart As a seal upon your arm
For love is as strong as death Jealousy as cruel as the gravy
Its flesh is a flash as a fire A most vehement flame
Many waters cannot quench love Nor can the floods drown it
My beloved is mine And I am free
Thank you.
